districts.label: Power Inn Industrial
districts.oneLineDistinction: Sacramento’s broadest established production and distribution district
districts.shortDescription: Power Inn is the City’s deepest reviewed industrial concentration, encompassing conventional warehouse, distribution, production, contractor and service operations across the Power Inn and Florin-Perkins area. It offers a broader and more industrial-led setting than Northgate / North Market. SCI and Ramona remain component contexts within this larger district rather than separate peers, and exact property capabilities still require building-level verification.
whatStandsOut: Power Inn and Florin-Perkins corridor identity
worthKnowing: SCI and Ramona are component areas, not separate public recommendation peers.
accessObservations: The City-defined Power Inn district follows the Power Inn Road commercial and industrial corridor.

districts.label: Northgate / North Market Industrial
districts.oneLineDistinction: Lighter warehouse and service space in northern Sacramento
districts.shortDescription: Northgate / North Market is a bounded northern Sacramento industrial area centered on Northgate and North Market Boulevard—not all of Natomas or North Sacramento. It is characterized by lighter warehouse, service-industrial, contractor and office/warehouse formats, including multi-tenant operating properties. Compared with Power Inn, its reviewed public role is narrower and more oriented to lighter service and flexible operating formats.
whatStandsOut: Bounded Northgate and North Market identity
worthKnowing: Do not interpret this district as all of Natomas or all of North Sacramento.

districts.label: River District / Richards Boulevard
districts.oneLineDistinction: Legacy distribution blocks inside a district shifting toward mixed use
districts.shortDescription: The River District retains established industrial, wholesale and distribution properties from its historic employment base, but it is also transitioning toward government offices, housing and mixed-use redevelopment. Industrial users may encounter functional legacy buildings here, yet the district should not be presented as a substitute for Sacramento’s deeper Power Inn or Northgate industrial areas. Its public value is explaining a transitional city-core operating context.
worthKnowing: Existing industrial use and long-term redevelopment direction vary block by block.
